metadata.fix_description: NBSP (U+00A0) line breaking bug: re_word regex in rich/_wrap.py uses \s which matches U+00A0 in Unicode mode, causing NBSP to be treated as a line break point.

work_order.objective: Apply a deterministic patch and verify it.
work_order.acceptance_criteria: The fixed verifier exits with status zero.

verification_steps.method: For each grant: verify_payload('capability-grant', grant, public_keys[grant.issuer_key_id])
For each receipt: verify_payload('action-receipt', receipt, public_keys[receipt.signer_key_id])
For each evidence payload: SHA-256(payload) must match reference.sha256
verify_composition_bundle(work_order, grants, attempts, receipts, evidence, reports, public_keys)
verify_acceptance_bundle(work_order, report, grants, attempts, receipts, evidence, acceptance_receipt, public_keys, reports)
